breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly instructs: 'Run a self‑consistent field (SCF) calculation on the original (unrelaxed) primitive structure,' which repeats the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires the final SCF to be performed on the vc-relaxed structure, not the original starting structure. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency and instead propagated the incorrect instruction.
